title: Correct Hosted Bandit baseline drift without weakening security
rawUserRequest: 继续完成根因整改，不要停在表面修复；减少重复全量测试但不能降低质量，所有流程问题应落地为可验证的防复发机制。

acceptance: The #523 source-bound architecture and all associated tests are reproduced from exact origin/main without importing or mutating #523 archive evidence.

Bandit reports no new findings from scripts/check_changed_critical_coverage.py or scripts/check_dev_tool_versions.py; all five prior B404/B603 findings are handled by precise rationale-bearing annotations for static list-form commands only.
The existing Bandit baseline remains byte-for-byte unchanged and make check-bandit-baseline passes with count 116 and its existing digest.
Regression tests prove the version-parity gate still fails on mismatched Ruff and passes under locked Ruff 0.16.0, and changed-critical coverage still covers all Git worktree states.
Focused regression, Bandit baseline, locked lint, format, source-bound evidence, documentation metadata, governance gates, and changed-critical coverage pass locally without lowering thresholds.
Hosted template-smoke, installation-smoke, release-evidence, ci-evidence, compatibility, and CodeQL are successful before merge.
guidelines: Use rationale-bearing nosec annotations only for immutable executable and argument lists; never suppress dynamic process construction or shell execution.
Preserve the existing Bandit baseline and all quality thresholds; resolve the new scanner findings in source rather than accepting drift.
Keep source-bound generated evidence synchronized after every bound implementation or test change.
Keep the failed #523 archive immutable and deliver this as one independent replacement Work Item and PR.

intent.problem: PR #523 fixed local/Hosted Ruff parity but its two newly added scripts introduced five low-risk Bandit findings. Hosted quality correctly rejected the resulting count/digest drift from the immutable 116-finding baseline after all 1614 tests and coverage gates had passed. The root cause is missing source-level documentation of fixed process boundaries, not an accepted new security risk or a need to revise the baseline.
constraints: Start from exact current origin/main and do not copy or rewrite #523 archive evidence.
Do not update the Bandit baseline, lower scanner rules, or use broad nosec suppression.
Each exception must be restricted to the known static interpreter/Git/pytest list-form invocation and explain why command injection is not introduced.
Use focused local checks under the recorded temporary efficiency exception; full Hosted quality remains mandatory.
intent.rationale: Source-level, reasoned Bandit annotations preserve a stable baseline and make the exceptional safety argument reviewable at the actual process boundary. A fresh Work Item preserves failed Hosted evidence truth while still delivering the already validated architectural fix.
